classification.difficultyReason: Translate each set symbol into shading on a supplied Venn diagram, including the overlap in the union.

content.prompt: The diagrams below show two intersecting sets $A$ and $B$. Shade the region corresponding to each expression.

spec.description: An unlabelled rectangle encloses equal overlapping circles, with A in the left-only region and B in the right-only region.
spec.mathematics: The two circles intersect and neither contains the other.
spec.answerVisibility: Student scaffold. All regions are unshaded.

answer.worked: The overlap consists of the outcomes in both $A$ and $B$. It is the region for $A\cap B$.

spec.sourceRegion: Fundamentals 2(a), answer PDF page 85, printed page 379
spec.description: The overlap alone is filled in house light blue in place of the source grey.
spec.mathematics: The filled lens is the intersection of the two circles.

spec.description: Second response copy of the same unlabelled rectangle and equal overlapping circles, with A on the left and B on the right.
spec.mathematics: The two circles intersect and neither contains the other.
spec.answerVisibility: Student scaffold. All regions are unshaded.

answer.short: Shade both circles, including the overlap.
answer.worked: The union $A\cup B$ includes outcomes in $A$, in $B$, or in both. Shade the full area inside either circle.

spec.sourceRegion: Fundamentals 2(b), answer PDF page 85, printed page 379
spec.description: Both circles, including the overlap, are filled in house light blue in place of the source grey. The exterior is unshaded.
spec.mathematics: The filled area is the union of the two circles.
